text:
Sunset's just passed and the sky's cooperating, clear skies easing into partly cloudy overnight with the low settling around 65. If you're still out on the waterfront, south winds are down to 10 to 15 knots and dropping through the evening, waves staying a foot or less, so it's a calm one to close out the day. Water's still sitting at a swimmable 74.

Tomorrow brings scattered showers and storms, but not until afternoon, and even then NWS and the models agree it's a lighter touch, 30 percent chance with less than a tenth of an inch. Morning through early afternoon looks mostly sunny with a high near 86. One thing to watch: ozone runs moderate Monday, so if you've got sensitive lungs, don't overdo the midday exertion outside. Otherwise, get your outdoor plans in before early afternoon, then keep half an eye on the sky heading into evening.

AFD KEY MESSAGES (forecaster's reasoning, issued 2026-07-26T18:54:00+00:00):
  1. Isolated to scattered showers and embedded thunderstorms are expected this afternoon and tomorrow afternoon, mainly across the Adirondacks, with isolated to scattered heavy downpours.
  2. More widespread showers and thunderstorms are expected by Tuesday, with the best chance for widespread precipitation expected Wednesday as a slow moving system tracks through the region.
  3. Trending drier heading into the first half of the weekend before showers return for Sunday.
AFD WHAT CHANGED: As of 236 PM EDT Sunday... No significant changes to the forecast at this time. Still anticipating daily scattered to numerous showers and possible sub severe embedded thunderstorms through Thursday.
LAKE (broad waters):
  Rest Of Today: South winds 5 to 10 knots. Partly sunny. Isolated showers and thunderstorms. Waves 1 foot or less.
  Tonight: South winds 10 to 15 knots, diminishing to less than 10 knots. Partly cloudy. Waves 1 foot or less.
  Monday: South winds less than 10 knots. Partly sunny. Scattered showers and thunderstorms in the afternoon. Waves 1 foot or less.
  Monday Night: Light and variable winds, becoming south 5 to 10 knots. Partly cloudy. Scattered showers and thunderstorms in the evening. Waves 1 to 3 feet.
LAKE GAGE: water 74F, level 95.57 ft (normal)

  high None, low 63: Partly cloudy. Lows overnight in the low 60s.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST: BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) -Happy Sunday! Our Sunday features a mixture of sunshine and clouds. There is a chance for spot showers here and there, especially over the higher elevations of northern New York. High temperatures for the day climb back into the upper 70s and low to mid 80s through this afternoon. Any showers we do see will dry up through this evening and tonight. Overnight lows fall back into the upper 50s and 60s by early Monday morning.
